meta.name: hass-builder
meta.description: A skill to build and manage Home Assistant configurations. Use when using the Home Assistant Builder (`hab`) CLI to inspect, create, update, delete, operate, or troubleshoot Home Assistant resources; when a user mentions hab, Home Assistant CLI automation, Lovelace/dashboard edits, helpers, automations, scripts, backups, ESPHome, or Home Assistant operations from a terminal.

copy.tagline: 用命令行管理 Home Assistant 配置与资源
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常用 Home Assistant 并习惯用终端操作
copy.tagline_en: Manage Home Assistant configurations and resources from the command line
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Home Assistant and prefer terminal-based management

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能通过命令行工具 hab 来查看、创建、修改或删除 Home Assistant 中的设备、自动化、仪表盘、备份等配置，并执行重启等操作。
howto.when: 当用户提到 hab、Home Assistant 自动化、仪表盘编辑、ESPHome 或终端操作时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 hab 创建一个自动化：当门磁传感器打开时开灯。
say.note: Claude 会生成对应的 hab 命令并预览。
Claude 会执行 hab entity list 命令。

say.text: 帮我备份 Home Assistant 系统。
say.note: Claude 会执行 hab backup 相关命令。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use the hab CLI to inspect, create, update, delete, or troubleshoot Home Assistant resources such as entities, automations, dashboards, backups, and perform system operations like restart.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions hab, Home Assistant CLI automation, Lovelace/dashboard edits, ESPHome, or terminal operations.

say_en.text: Create an automation with hab: turn on light when door sensor opens.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the hab command and preview.
Claude will run hab entity list.

say_en.text: Back up my Home Assistant system.
say_en.note: Claude will run hab backup commands.
